journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association

articles.title_en: FBBVA Lecture 2025: Negative Rates and the Effective Lower Bound: Theory and Evidence
articles.title_cn: FBBVA讲座2025：负利率与有效下限：理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: With the monetary policy lower bound a re-emerging concern in some locations, we present new insights on the impact of negative policy rates. We develop a new theoretical model to match the empirical evidence on their effects. The model features a heterogeneous, oligopolistic banking sector where loan pricing is determined in part by the availability of deposit funding and in part by wholesale funding. The use of non-deposit funding ensures that the bank lending channel of negative rates remains active. We explore the impact of the policy on different types of banks: High-deposit banks may experience a fall in interest margins and profitability, which can result in reduced lending. But this is more than compensated for by greater lending from low-deposit banks. We embed this banking sector in an open-economy macroeconomic model, featuring exchange-rate and capital market transmission channels, which continue to work as normal when rates are negative. These non-bank channels, combined with general equilibrium effects and an active bank lending channel, mean that the transmission of negative rates is only somewhat weaker than the transmission of conventional policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着货币政策下限在某些地区再次成为关注焦点，我们提出了关于负政策利率影响的新见解。我们开发了一个新的理论模型来匹配其效应的实证证据。该模型具有一个异质性、寡头垄断的银行业部门，其中贷款定价部分取决于存款资金的可用性，部分取决于批发融资。非存款融资的使用确保了负利率的银行信贷渠道保持活跃。我们探讨了该政策对不同类型银行的影响：高存款银行可能会经历利息边际和盈利能力的下降，这可能导致贷款减少。但这被低存款银行更多的贷款所补偿。我们将这一银行业部门嵌入一个开放经济宏观经济模型中，该模型具有汇率和资本市场传导渠道，在利率为负时这些渠道继续正常工作。这些非银行渠道，结合一般均衡效应和活跃的银行信贷渠道，意味着负利率的传导仅比传统政策的传导稍弱。

articles.title_en: Schumpeter Lecture 2025 : The New Causal Macroeconomics of Surveys and Experiments
articles.title_cn: 熊彼特讲座 2025：调查与实验的新因果宏观经济学
articles.abstract_en: We discuss how randomized control trials (RCTs) can be used to study the causal effects of expectations on the decisions of households, firms, and other economic agents. Specifically, information provision in RCTs can create exogenous variation in the beliefs of survey participants and thus can address a key identification challenge that has plagued research efforts focused on understanding the role of expectations in shaping economic decisions. When linked to either external information on their actions or subsequent survey waves that measure their ex-post decisions, RCTs can provide clear causal identification of the passthrough from expectations to decisions. We review recent evidence using this strategy and discuss potential challenges associated with this approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们讨论了如何利用随机对照试验（RCTs）来研究预期对家庭、企业及其他经济主体决策的因果效应。具体而言，RCTs中的信息提供可以创造调查参与者信念的外生变异，从而解决一个关键的识别挑战，这一挑战一直困扰着旨在理解预期在塑造经济决策中作用的研究努力。当与关于其行为的外部信息或测量其事后决策的后续调查波次相结合时，RCTs可以提供从预期到决策传导的清晰因果识别。我们回顾了使用这一策略的最新证据，并讨论了与此方法相关的潜在挑战。

articles.title_en: Marshall Lecture 2025: Political Information and Network Effects
articles.title_cn: 马歇尔讲座 2025：政治信息与网络效应
articles.abstract_en: Why do political campaigns so often yield unexpected results? We address this question by separately estimating the direct effect of a campaign on targeted voters and the indirect effect on others in the same social environment. Partnering with a local NGO during Argentina’s 2023 presidential election, we randomized the distribution of leaflets providing an expert assessment of the likely consequences of certain proposals by the outsider candidate Javier Milei. Exploiting Argentina’s unique sub-precinct election reporting system, we show that the campaign reduced Milei’s support among directly treated voters, as expected, but increased his support among untreated voters in treated precincts, producing a backfiring, net-positive effect for Milei. A pre-registered replication confirmed these opposite-signed effects. Using theory and a survey experiment, we show that the minority of voters who disbelieved the campaign were more motivated to discuss it with peers, convincing them to support Milei. This mobilization effect appears especially likely when campaigns criticize outsider candidates. Our results highlight how campaigns aimed at anti-elite candidates can unintentionally mobilize support for them.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么政治竞选活动常常产生出乎意料的结果？我们通过分别估计竞选活动对目标选民的直接效应和对同一社会环境中其他人的间接效应来回答这个问题。在阿根廷 2023 年总统选举期间，我们与一家当地非政府组织合作，随机分发了传单，其中提供了外部候选人哈维尔·米莱某些提案可能后果的专家评估。利用阿根廷独特的子选区选举报告系统，我们表明，该竞选活动按预期减少了直接受助选民对米莱的支持，但增加了受助选区中未受助选民对他的支持，产生了适得其反的、对米莱净正面的效应。一项预注册的复制实验证实了这些符号相反的效应。通过理论和调查实验，我们表明，少数不相信该竞选活动的选民更有动力与同伴讨论此事，说服他们支持米莱。这种动员效应在竞选活动批评外部候选人时尤其可能出现。我们的结果凸显了针对反精英候选人的竞选活动如何可能无意中为其动员支持。

articles.title_en: Safe Spaces for Teenage Girls in a Time of Crisis
articles.title_cn: 危机时期少女的安全空间
articles.abstract_en: Adolescent girls across low-income countries face disadvantages stemming from limited agency over their bodies and barriers to investing in their human capital. We study how these outcomes are shaped in times of aggregate crisis, in the context of the 2014–2016 Ebola epidemic in Sierra Leone. This is a setting in which adolescent girls have long faced disadvantage because of a high prevalence of sexual exploitation and violence towards them. Our study is based around an evaluation of a club-based intervention for young women implemented during the epidemic. We track 2,700 girls aged 12–18 from the eve of the epidemic in 2014 to just prior to when Sierra Leone was declared Ebola free in 2016. The club-based intervention provides a safe space where girls can spend time away from men, receive advice on reproductive health, vocational training, and/or microfinance. During the epidemic all schools were closed. We show that without the protection of time in school, in control villages teenage girls spent more time with men, pregnancy rates rose sharply, and their school enrolment dropped post-epidemic. The provision of a safe space breaks this causal chain: It enables girls in treated villages to allocate time away from men and reduce out-of-wedlock pregnancies. These effects are most pronounced in places where girls face the highest predicted pregnancy risks. In such locations, the intervention also increases school re-enrolment rates post-epidemic. To further pin down mechanisms, we exploit a second layer of randomization of input bundles offered by clubs. This reinforces the idea that the safe space component is critical to driving outcomes for teenage girls. Our analysis has implications for school closures during health crisis in contexts where young women face sexual violence, highlighting the protective and lasting role safe spaces can provide in such times.
articles.abstract_cn: 低收入国家的少女因对自己身体的自主权有限以及人力资本投资障碍而面临不利处境。我们以塞拉利昂2014-2016年埃博拉疫情为背景，研究这些结果在总体危机时期如何形成。在这一环境中，由于针对少女的性剥削和暴力行为高发，她们长期处于不利地位。我们的研究基于对疫情期间实施的针对年轻女性的俱乐部干预项目的评估。我们追踪了从疫情前夕2014年到塞拉利昂宣布无埃博拉疫情之前2016年的2,700名年龄在12-18岁的女孩。俱乐部干预提供了一个安全空间，女孩们可以在那里远离男性，获得生殖健康建议、职业培训和/或小额信贷。疫情期间所有学校都关闭了。我们表明，在没有学校时间保护的情况下，对照村的少女与男性相处的时间更多，怀孕率急剧上升，疫情后她们的入学率下降。提供安全空间打破了这一因果链条：它使处理村的女孩能够将时间分配远离男性，并减少非婚怀孕。这些效应在女孩面临最高预测怀孕风险的地方最为显著。在这些地区，干预还提高了疫情后的重新入学率。为进一步确定机制，我们利用了俱乐部提供的投入组合的第二层随机化。这强化了安全空间成分对推动少女结果至关重要的观点。我们的分析对健康危机期间学校关闭在年轻女性面临性暴力的情境中具有启示意义，强调了安全空间在此类时期可以提供的保护性和持久作用。

articles.title_en: Mobile Apps and Targeted Advertising: Competitive Effects of Data Sharing
articles.title_cn: 移动应用与定向广告：数据共享的竞争效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of data sharing among mobile apps, leveraging iOS’s policy that limits tracking users using identifiers. We find that this restriction decreases average new downloads by 3.96%. The effect is primarily driven by large apps that heavily rely on third-party data to acquire users (resulting in overlapping effects), and developers who lack first-party data (resulting in a lack of information advantage). However, new app introductions, particularly by first-time developers, decrease following the restriction, implying that large incumbent apps may gain increased dominance in the long run and offset their reduction in market concentration from user acquisition.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用iOS限制使用标识符追踪用户的政策，考察了移动应用间数据共享的影响。我们发现，这一限制使平均新下载量下降了3.96%。这一效应主要由严重依赖第三方数据获取用户的大型应用（导致重叠效应）以及缺乏第一方数据的开发者（导致信息优势缺失）所驱动。然而，新应用的推出，尤其是首次开发者推出的应用，在限制实施后有所减少，这意味着大型在位应用可能在长期内获得更强的市场主导地位，并抵消其在用户获取方面市场集中度的降低。

articles.title_en: Sparking Knowledge: Early Technology Adoption, Innovation Ability and Long-Run Growth
articles.title_cn: 点燃知识：早期技术采纳、创新能力与长期增长
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the benefits of first-mover advantages in technology adoption. It documents that the early adoption of electricity across late 19th-century Switzerland was conducive to local economic development not just in the short run but also in the long run. By exploiting exogenous variation in waterpower potential, alongside rapid advancements in power transmission technology, these findings can be interpreted as causal. The main mechanism through which differences in economic development persist is increased human capital accumulation and innovativeness. In contrast, I was unable to uncover any evidence supporting a number of alternative mechanisms: (1) persistent differences in the use of electricity, (2) household electrification, (3) local gains from resource windfalls, (4) returns to scale and physical capital accumulation, and (5) population agglomeration.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了技术采纳中先发优势的益处。文章记录了19世纪末瑞士电力早期采纳不仅对短期地方经济发展有利，而且对长期发展也有利。通过利用水能潜力的外生变异以及电力传输技术的快速进步，这些发现可以被解释为因果关系。经济发展差异持续存在的主要机制是人力资本积累和创新能力的增强。相比之下，我未能找到支持多种替代机制的证据：（1）电力使用的持续差异，（2）家庭电气化，（3）资源意外收益的地方收益，（4）规模报酬和物质资本积累，以及（5）人口集聚。

articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场动态与增长
articles.abstract_en: This paper seeks to understand the implications of incorporating economic growth into a search-theoretic model of the labor market. To this end, a technological diffusion process is embedded into the canonical search and matching model of the labor market. New matches imitate the production process of incumbents. Although the canonical model is only modified slightly, there are stark differences in economic intuition across the two models. Market tightness is equilibrated through a different margin, and comparative statics of the two models are qualitatively different. Additionally, the model with endogenous growth—consistent with empirical data—generates stronger unemployment cyclicality than a similarly calibrated model without endogenous growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在探讨将经济增长纳入劳动力市场搜寻理论模型中的含义。为此，我们将技术扩散过程嵌入到标准的劳动力市场搜寻与匹配模型中。新匹配模仿现有企业的生产过程。尽管对标准模型的修改很小，但两个模型在经济直觉上存在显著差异。市场紧度通过不同的边际进行均衡，且两个模型的比较静态分析在性质上有所不同。此外，与经验数据一致的内生增长模型，比没有内生增长的类似校准模型产生了更强的失业周期性。

articles.title_en: The Pick of the Crop: Agricultural Practices and Clustered Networks in Village Economies
articles.title_cn: 作物之选：乡村经济中的农业实践与集群网络
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how social networks (might fail to) shape agricultural practices. We exploit (1) a unique census of agricultural production nested within delineated land parcels and (2) social network data within four repopulated villages of rural Vietnam. In the first step, we extract exogenous variation in network formation from home locations within the few streets that compose each village (populated through staggered population resettlement), and we estimate the return to social links in the adoption of highly productive crops. We find a large network multiplier in apparent contradiction with low adoption rates. In the second step, we study the structure of network formation to explain this puzzle: Social networks display large homophily, and valuable links between heterogeneous households are rare. Due to the clustered nature of networks and the dynamic, endogenous propagation of agricultural practices, there are decreasing returns to social links, and policies targeting “inbetweeners” are most able to mitigate this issue.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究社会网络如何（可能未能）塑造农业实践。我们利用（1）一份独特的农业生产普查数据，该数据嵌套在划分好的地块内，以及（2）越南四个重新安置村庄的社会网络数据。第一步，我们从构成每个村庄的少数街道（通过分阶段人口重新安置而 populated）内的家庭位置中提取网络形成的外生变异，并估计社会联系在采用高生产力作物中的回报。我们发现一个巨大的网络乘数，这与低采用率明显矛盾。第二步，我们研究网络形成的结构以解释这一谜团：社会网络表现出高度的同质性，而异质家庭之间有价值的联系很少。由于网络的集群性质以及农业实践的动态、内生传播，社会联系的回报递减，而针对“中间人”的政策最能缓解这一问题。

articles.title_en: The Persistent Effect of Competition on Prosociality
articles.title_cn: 竞争对亲社会行为的持续影响
articles.abstract_en: We present the first causal evidence on the persistent impact of enduring competition on prosociality. Inspired by the literature on tournaments within firms, which shows that competitive compensation schemes reduce cooperation in the short-run, we explore if enduring exposure to a competitive environment persistently attenuates prosociality. Based on a large-scale randomized intervention in the education context, we find lower levels of prosociality for students who just experienced a 2-year competition period. Four-year follow-up data indicate that the effect persists and generalizes, suggesting a change in traits and not only in behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于持久竞争对亲社会行为持续影响的首次因果证据。受企业内部锦标赛文献的启发，该文献表明竞争性薪酬方案在短期内减少合作，我们探讨了长期暴露于竞争环境是否持续削弱亲社会行为。基于教育领域的一项大规模随机干预，我们发现刚刚经历2年竞争期的学生表现出较低水平的亲社会行为。四年后的跟踪数据表明，这种影响持续存在并具有普遍性，表明这不仅是行为上的变化，更是特质上的改变。

articles.title_en: Markups, Production Relocation, and the Gains from Trade
articles.title_cn: 加成率、生产转移与贸易收益
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a multisector, multicountry model of international trade and profit shifting that embeds imperfect competition into Eaton and Kortum (2002)’s Ricardian trade model and allows markup distributions for both imports and exports to vary across sectors and countries. We first show theoretically how the gains from trade liberalization depend on the markup distribution for imported relative to exported goods. To bring the model to the data, we estimate both trade elasticities and a rich set of country- and industry-specific import demand elasticities for over 36,000 distinct sector-country pairs. We find that cross-country heterogeneities in export markups relative to import markups are a first-order determinant of the gains from trade and especially the welfare losses from tariffs. By flexibly taking heterogeneity in markups into account, these losses are up to three times larger for net exporters of high-markup products. We apply our model to the 2018–19 U.S.–China trade war and show that U.S. welfare losses from the tariff war are more than twice as high once markups and profit shifting are taken into account, whereas China benefited slightly overall.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个多部门、多国家的国际贸易与利润转移模型，将不完全竞争嵌入Eaton和Kortum（2002）的李嘉图贸易模型中，并允许进口和出口的加成率分布在不同部门和不同国家之间变化。我们首先从理论上展示了贸易自由化的收益如何取决于进口相对于出口商品的加成率分布。为了将模型应用于数据，我们估计了超过36,000个不同的部门-国家对的贸易弹性以及一组丰富的国家和行业特定的进口需求弹性。我们发现，出口加成率相对于进口加成率的跨国异质性是贸易收益以及尤其是关税福利损失的一阶决定因素。通过灵活考虑加成率的异质性，对于高加成率产品的净出口国，这些损失最多可增加三倍。我们将模型应用于2018-19年中美贸易战，并表明一旦考虑加成率和利润转移，美国因关税战遭受的福利损失是原来的两倍多，而中国总体上略有受益。
